title: View of the centennial flood innudating the railroad bridge (NYPL b11707683-G90F075 020ZF)
blurb: * Views of Norwich, Connecticut: includes general and street views including a view of the Governor's Guard in Franklin square; waterfront scenes, including steamboats "City of New York" and "W.W. Coit," railroad tracks along the river, the centennial flood innudating the railroad bridge, Norwich falls, and Yantic falls in the winter; views of homes including H. K. Hammond's and a rambling wooden house labelled "oldest house"; view of men working on the foundation of a house; views of business blocks, including one with a Western Union Office; a large mill building with two towers; churches, including interiors; the Otis Library; tunnel on the Norwich and Western Railroad; New London County courthouse. Includes views by various photographers and publishers. Robert Dennis Collection of Stereoscopic Views. Title devised by cataloger.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.16% vertical error and 0.0° of rotation. Depth measured gentle (0.34% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
